room.scope: Full drawing-buffer pixel centers, no MSAA. Surface/alpha/depth from the posed room materials. Two finite cylinders run from the raw ankles to their 22-point boot openings; radius is the maximum cuff radius plus 30 mm. Skin without a same-band clothing pixel behind may be an opening. Foremost boot or pants alone does not establish an intersection. Ambiguous pixels include partial transparency and overlapping leg bands; silhouette/MSAA boundaries and other camera directions are unmeasured.
